focusedEvidence.command: apps/desktop focused Vitest, strict TypeScript compilation, and lint
focusedEvidence.scope: Four Research Intent workspace tests and the desktop static/type boundary prove that the human acceptance surface binds the exact persisted revision and content hash, requires rationale and confirmation, disables acceptance for incomplete, accepted, or unsaved state, and leaves draft launch disabled.

Twelve service tests prove exact confirmed acceptance, stale and unconfirmed denial, restart-safe idempotency, six-mode policy enforcement, durable audit, failure rollback, and accepted-revision cache replacement.

implementationScope: Complete the already approved Research Intent Contract workflow by exposing its existing Core human-acceptance boundary in the desktop workspace. Reuse Academic Minimal panels, buttons, badges, consent language, and field patterns; bind acceptance to a decision-complete persisted revision and exact content hash; require researcher rationale and confirmation; invalidate consent on unsaved edits; keep draft launch disabled; and do not change routes, tokens, illustrative reference data, or the approved reference.
